title: WPSS/1706/2005 of KANTI RANA Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
WPSS No.1706 of 2005
Honíble B.S. Verma, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Standing Counsel for the
State.
By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has
sought a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding
and directing the respondents to promote the petitioner to
the post of Senior Assistant from the date she became
eligible thereto and further to grant her all consequential
benefits or in alternate to promote her to the post of Senior
Assistant from the date other persons were promoted i.e.
18-12-2004 along with all consequential benefits.
A counter affidavit has been filed by the State
wherein at para-14 it has been stated that the petitioner
has been promoted to the post of Senior Assistant vide
memo no. 7223/ Mu.A./ C.V./ Karmik/ E-10 dated
28.12.2005. Copy of the office memo dated 28.12.2005 has
been annexed as Annexure C.A.1, which also reveals that
the petitioner has been promoted from the date of order
i.e. 28.12.2005.
So far as the grievance of the petitioner to promote
her is concerned, the same has been redressed, as
observed aforesaid. Now, the only grievance is as to
whether the petitioner is entitled for promotion from
18.12.2004 along with all consequential benefits. For that
relief, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission
to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to file a fresh
petition for redressal of her remaining grievances.
Permission is granted.
Writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty
to the petitioner either to file a fresh writ petition or to
approach appropriate forum for redressal of his
grievances.
